verdict.rationale: The evidence documents GPU backends (CUDA, HIP, MUSA, Metal) and CPU+GPU hybrid inference. Nothing in it describes diagnostic output that explains why GPU acceleration failed or that flags a silent fallback to CPU. Community comments about GPU layer limits and speedups say nothing about diagnostic messaging for fallback.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
